source_clock_spans.value: Orders released before 14:20 depart the same operating day.
Orders released at or after 14:20 depart the next operating day, unless a customs hold prevents departure.
Requests released before 11:45 are shipped the same working day.
At or after 11:45, departure is the next working day, unless a seed inspection hold is still active.
At Sable Travelling Books, orders released before 14:20 depart on the same service day.
Orders released at or after 14:20 depart on the following service day, unless a road-closure hold is in effect.
Release ticket orders before 13:35 for departure on the same service day.
Ticket orders released at or after 13:35 depart on the next service day, unless a wind-suspension hold remains active.
Orders released before 14:10 leave on the same collection day.
At or after 14:10, departure is the next collection day, unless a seed-health hold remains active.
Dispatch requests released before 12:40 leave on the current service day.
At or after 12:40, departure moves to the following service day, unless a conservation hold is still active.
Dispatch requests cleared before 16:20 leave on the current service day.
At 16:20 or later, departure is the next service day, unless an optical-safety hold is open.
Dispatch requests released before 14:35 leave on the current service day.
At 14:35 or later, departure is the next service day, unless a phytosanitary hold is open.
